title: Adopt Apps
description: Move the Angular apps of this workspace that build without the plugin to its release target, in place: release target (base hrefs and post-build steps read from the workspace's own build script), environments/<app>/htaccess.<env>, env encryption settings, build:<app>:<env> npm scripts. Old scripts are kept.

projects.description: Apps to adopt (default: every Angular app without a release target).

scripts.description: Point the apps' build:<app>:<env> npm scripts at nx run <app>:release:<env>.
